# /impact — report a contract's affected set (contracts, packages, owners)

Thin macro over the existing traversal and attribution engines. `$ARGUMENTS` is a contract path
under `contracts/` (or a bare graph node id). Composes `direct`/`reverse`/`transitive`
(`tools/contract_graph/query.py`) over the compiled contract graph, plus the Phase-47 package
facts, into one report — it defines no traversal of its own.

An unresolved contract produces a clean refusal (non-zero exit) that names what was searched —
never an empty "nothing affected" success, which would read as "safe to edit" when it actually
means "I could not find your contract."

Exit codes are three distinct signals, never collapsed: `0` resolved, `1` clean refusal
(unresolved contract), `2` usage error (missing argument), `3` internal error (a malformed
`harness/project.toml` or another unhandled failure — fix the config/tool, not the contract path).

!`uv run python -m tools.contract_graph.impact "$ARGUMENTS"`
